heading: Sunday
text: Rain south of Rt. 4, a good chance north, becoming more scattered north of Route 2. Highs in the upper 50s south, rising into the mid-60s north. Northeast wind 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, stronger localized gusts possible.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers continuing south of Route 2, more scattered north. Lows in the 40s low 50s. Northeast wind diminishing.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly cloudy. Rain showers mainly south of route 2. Highs from the upper 50s south, to mid-60s north. Light northeast wind north, increasing to near 10 mph south.
